text:
tess: quick sync — saw repeated p99 spikes after the window-compaction merge. suspect compaction + eviction interplay. thinking of an "elastic spill" per-tenant to absorb bursts for ~30-50ms before promoting to slowpath. quick thoughts?

raj: can you paste a short trace?

tess: trimmed span:
```
enqueue 2ms
coalesce 12ms
batch_wait 280ms <-- long
gpu_dispatch 6ms
kernel 18ms
```

mo: overflow into a tiny per-tenant ring sounds good. key is bounded memory and avoiding noisy-neighbor drain hogging.

anya: two quick constraints: 1) p50 can't get worse, 2) memory cap ~64MB spare/GPU. Also want observability hooks.

tess: simple sketch: main_queue accepts until soft_limit (e.g., 75%). overflow -> tenant_spill ring with TTL 40ms. admission uses prob p = max(p_floor, 1 - occupancy). drain: when forming a batch we pull up to D tokens per tenant, prioritizing explicit deadlines then synth-deadline then round-robin. TTL expiry -> slowpath.

raj: add kv_fingerprint on spill entries so slowpath can avoid redundant cache loads.

mo: fairness tokens per-dispatch is necessary. otherwise big tenant can starve others during drain.

anya: metrics to add: spill_enqueue{tenant}, spill_drain{tenant}, spill_ttl_expire{tenant}, avg_spill_hold_ms, spill_cpu_ms, slowpath_promote_rate. plus traces for path variants.

ops-bot: deploy checklist: runtime.elastic_spill feature-flag; canary 5%; alert if slowpath_promote_rate > 1% for any tenant.

tess: next steps: raj implement ring + kv tag; mo add fairness tokens + drain ordering; anya spec metrics + console knobs; I'll draft a short RFC addendum. target canary in 10 days.

raj: I'll run multi-tenant stress tests once implemented.

mo: agree — keep initial admit_prob simple, iterate after telemetry.

tess: thanks — small and reversible, please keep tests for TTL and memory bndg. :thumbsup:
